purpose: Input methods in the browser build: winit 0.30's web backend implements none, so the page's composition events reach Iced's text widgets through this crate instead.
local_changes: src/web_ime.rs (new, wasm32 only): on_input_method tells the page where a text widget's cursor is, or that none wants text; send queues winit Ime events from the page and wakes the window
src/lib.rs: declare web_ime on wasm32; deliver the queued Ime events before each window event; register the window that send wakes
src/lib.rs: on wasm32, size the canvas through CSSOM instead of a style attribute, which a strict Content-Security-Policy (style-src without 'unsafe-inline') blocks, leaving a 300x150 canvas
Cargo.toml: web-sys CssStyleDeclaration and HtmlElement for that
src/window.rs: on wasm32, report the input method area to web_ime when Iced enables, moves or disables it
LICENSE (added): Iced's MIT license, which the crate package does not include; the same text as licenses/iced/LICENSE
